sql.insert_poll: INSERT INTO n_post_polls (poll_id,post_id,group_post_id,allow_multiple,closes_at) SELECT :poll_id,:post_id,:group_post_id,:allow_multiple,TO_TIMESTAMP(:closes_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') FROM dual WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(:closes_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') > SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP)
sql.read: SELECT p.poll_id,p.allow_multiple,TO_CHAR(p.closes_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS closes_at,CASE WHEN p.closes_at<=SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_closed,o.option_id,o.option_text,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_post_poll_ballots b WHERE b.poll_id=p.poll_id) AS total_ballots,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n_post_poll_votes v WHERE v.poll_id=p.poll_id AND v.option_id=o.option_id) AS votes_count,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_poll_votes v WHERE v.poll_id=p.poll_id AND v.option_id=o.option_id AND v.user_id=:viewer_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS selected FROM n_post_polls p JOIN n_post_poll_options o ON o.poll_id=p.poll_id WHERE (:is_group=0 AND p.post_id=:post_id) OR (:is_group=1 AND p.group_post_id=:post_id) ORDER BY o.option_id
sql.insert_ballot: INSERT INTO n_post_poll_ballots (poll_id,user_id) SELECT p.poll_id,:user_id FROM n_post_polls p WHERE p.poll_id=:poll_id AND p.closes_at>SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP)
sql.any_table_present: SELECT 1 FROM user_tables WHERE table_name IN ('N_POST_POLLS','N_POST_POLL_OPTIONS','N_POST_POLL_BALLOTS','N_POST_POLL_VOTES') AND ROWNUM=1
